summary: Citizenship claim by person born abroad to Indian parents; eligibility under Article 8 (Constitution) vs Citizenship Act 1955 s.5(1)(b), s.8(2); grandparents born pre-independence in undivided India; parents renounced Indian citizenship after acquiring Singapore citizenship; timing of application post-majority; constitutional citizenship (Article 8) vs statutory routes; interpretation of 'minor child' in s.8(2); High Court upheld citizenship, Union appeal dismissed.
final_judgment: Appeal dismissed, High Court judgment upheld; respondent entitled to Indian citizenship.
